# The one package that .github/workflows/semgrep.yml installs, at an exact version.
#
# The pin keeps two runs of the same commit from being judged by two different
# engines. Dependabot reads this file and proposes a newer release as a pull
# request, after the same week of waiting that cargo gets, and the checks on that
# pull request are the answer to whether the new engine still behaves.
#
# Only this package is pinned. What it needs is resolved by pip when the job runs,
# so a run can differ from the last one in a dependency of Semgrep. The job holds
# no secret and a read-only token, which is what makes that acceptable. Pinning
# every dependency with hashes is the next step if this ever changes.
semgrep==1.178.0
